Fetch drives verify every delivered ID/hash/key against the KL09-07 synth layout and fail on any mismatch or paused-partition delivery; retry reports metadata RPCs per retried batch (165 metadata / 8 faulted batches = 20.62; no-fault baseline bulk issues 1 metadata RPC); connect reports per-case first-ack microseconds plus open sockets.
Artifacts follow the KL09-09 format (generalized RunContext: profile bulk/fetch, merged multi-broker counts, extra execution fields); 9/9 validate with benchmark-report.py, 0 errors.

limits: Null-broker (loopback) tier only: numbers measure client-side headroom, never feed claims (Suite HOLD active; cells registered exploratory/feeds_claims=false).
Fetch per-record latency is the enclosing fetch() call's duration (delivery bound), not a per-RPC RTT; under default fetch sizing most cells complete in 1 round, so p99 equals the single round.

capped-paused max_poll_records=1 caps records per fetch() call, not per RPC: the client buffers the full partition (20k) in 1 RPC and dribbles from memory; the ~19k allocs/round is the measured drain cost and a wave-D target.
Multinode slow node delivered 0 records (target reached from fast nodes first): fast-node rec/s is exact, p99 is fast-only; the client demonstrably does not head-of-line block on the slow node.
Retry batch_records=20 is a documented harness default (needed for ~1000 requests so 1% faults fire reliably); metadata ratio includes ~1 baseline bootstrap RPC.
Connect dead host is refused-fast 127.0.0.1:1, not a blackhole; socket counts are Linux socket fds, total fds elsewhere (labeled).
nullbroker gained metadata_requests/injected_requests/injected_errors counters plus artifact fields (bench-crate observability for the retry metric; core crate untouched).
